title: Add dashboards + alerts for suggestions-service (latency/5xx/stale estimates) with runbook links
author: Rafael Mendes
description:
Context: As we prepare the Suggestions Console UX beta, we need first-class observability for the suggestions-service and its dependent data freshness signals to safely operate the cohort behind feature flags.

This PR adds (1) Grafana dashboards for suggestions-service API health + suggestion freshness, (2) alert rules for p95 latency, 5xx rate, and stale estimates, and (3) runbook links from dashboards/alerts for on-call triage.

Dashboards:
- Suggestions / Service Overview: request rate, p50/p95/p99, 4xx/5xx, saturation (worker pool), upstream dependency latency (telemetry-baselines + config/tenancy)
- Suggestions / Data Quality: baseline freshness, estimate freshness distribution, "insufficient telemetry" rate, and cache hit ratio (service-side)

Alerts (Prometheus -> Alertmanager -> PagerDuty for page, Slack for ticket):
- suggestions_service_p95_latency_high (page): p95 > 1.25s for 10m on GET /suggestions or GET /suggestions/{id}
- suggestions_service_5xx_rate_high (page): 5xx > 1.0% for 10m (guarded by min QPS to avoid noise)
- suggestions_service_error_budget_burn (ticket): multi-window burn on 5xx and latency (6h/30m)
- suggestions_estimates_stale (page): > 5% of suggestions returned have estimate_age > 24h for 15m OR pipeline_last_success_age > 6h (beta cohort only)
- suggestions_estimates_missing_freshness_signal (ticket): freshness gauge absent for 30m (catch regressions in instrumentation)

Runbooks:
- Adds docs/runbooks/suggestions-service.md and links it from dashboard annotations + alert annotations (runbook_url label).
- Runbook includes: common failure modes (stale baselines, cache stampede, tenant scoping errors manifesting as 4xx spikes), immediate mitigations (feature flag off / degrade to "insufficient data"), and how to confirm via traces/logs.

Notes:
- Alert thresholds are calibrated to beta expectations and can be tightened post-cohort. I explicitly avoided paging on 4xx spikes because we expect gating/RBAC-related 403/404 patterns during allowlisting.

Checklist:
- [x] Dashboards added to repo + provisioned in grafana
- [x] Alert rules added with owners + runbook links
- [x] Verified in staging with synthetic traffic
- [x] Documented on-call playbook + links

Refs: ENG-2407

conversation: Allison Grant (review): Dashboard layout looks good. Two nits: (1) please align the latency panels to use the same histogram bucket metric we standardized on (http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket), and (2) can we add a small panel for "no data" rate so we can quickly see when the UI would show empty/insufficient telemetry states?

Rafael Mendes (author): Good call on the metric name — the service was still exporting request_duration_seconds_bucket from the scaffolding. Switched to http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket and updated all queries. Also added a "suggestions_returned_with_missing_basis" panel + a "insufficient_telemetry" counter panel in the Data Quality dashboard.

Logan Wright (review): For stale estimates: I like the dual signal (percentage stale + pipeline last success). However, the pipeline_last_success_age threshold at 6h might page during planned backfills/warehouse maintenance. Can we gate that page to only beta-allowed tenants and/or add a maintenance silence note to the runbook?

Rafael Mendes (author): Updated rules: (a) the stale-estimates paging alert is now guarded behind suggestions_beta_enabled="true" (we already label that on the service via config) and (b) added a runbook section on planned telemetry maintenance + recommended silences. Also added a ticket-level alert if the metric goes missing so we still catch instrumentation regressions.

Chloe Martin (review): One more request: can we include a trace link template in the runbook (Tempo) and confirm the alerts include route/method labels? When we had the 5xx spike last week we needed to narrow to GET /suggestions quickly.

Rafael Mendes (author): Added tempo link template + log search examples (service=suggestions-service, request_id, tenant_id hashed). Alerts now include method + route where cardinality is bounded (route is normalized to /suggestions and /suggestions/:id).
Allison Grant (approval): Approved. Thanks for keeping the route label bounded; this will save us pain later.
Logan Wright (approval): Approved after the gating change. Please keep an eye on false positives once cohort is enabled.
Rafael Mendes (author): Squashed and merged. Will coordinate with Connor (release eng) to ensure dashboards are provisioned in prod during the beta rollout window.
release_notes: Added Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts for suggestions-service latency, error rate, and estimate freshness, with runbook links for on-call.
